qualification.initial_failure: Run 40089690321 failed a vacuously true empty-iterator assertion in the final aggregation. The assertion was removed without changing the preregistered scientific protocol, world behavior, evaluator or tested method outcomes, then all 85 tests passed on both operating systems.

world.state_dependent: P2 flips latent state for later actions; external unannounced hidden flip can occur at checking step 6
world.train_check: Novel initial phase each checking episode; same stationary structural hypothesis and three invented development families

scientific_interpretation.bounded_positive: Compared with static per-code last-effect memory, local phase-corrected memory gains correct predictions in a deterministic hidden-state transition task and persists source-bound public learner state across a simulated restart.
scientific_interpretation.tradeoff: Local method obtains 21/36 pre-feedback hits versus conservative Bayesian 18/36, but incurs six factually wrong confident predictions while the strong Bayesian method makes zero such errors under clean feedback. This is an accuracy-coverage tradeoff, not robust dominance.
scientific_interpretation.sensor_negative: Under inverted delayed feedback, the local mechanism makes only six correct predictions and 21 incorrect nonabstained predictions. This fails robustness and cannot support scientific GO.
scientific_interpretation.state_dynamics_scope: The P2 state transition and possible step-six interference model family are explicitly programmed and disclosed to both methods. No discovery of these causal laws or independently unfamiliar family is shown.
scientific_interpretation.resource_limits: Per-method CPU/wall time and traced Python peak were measured by source but complete matched FLOPs/energy and end-to-end Pareto are unavailable. Cross-host numerical core excludes timings.
scientific_interpretation.independent_full_regression: The previous frozen L10-B6 evidence commit 51d9494875437c4124d9fc40ce40215462a6878c passed Linux/Windows FORGE regression run 40088359784; final B7 evidence head regression must be verified separately.

next_gate: Freeze L10-B7 as a development mixed finding. To advance ITD-02, require a genuinely unfamiliar dynamical family whose action-state transition rules must be learned rather than coded, with causally informative interventions, delayed feedback, strict false-positive/factual fidelity thresholds and strong fitted state-space/Bayesian controls, and full resource accounting before any first use. Do not tune B7 based on DEV_CHECK scores.
